dataset.name: Contiguous U.S. state population density
dataset.source: U.S. Census Bureau 2024 cartographic state boundaries and Vintage 2025 state population estimates
dataset.license: U.S. Census Bureau public data; cite the Census Bureau as source.
dataset.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Cartographic Boundary File, States, 1:20m; U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 state resident population estimates.
dataset.provenance: Prepared from Census boundary and population files by filtering to the 48 contiguous states, projecting rings with a spherical Albers equal-area transform, and encoding log10 resident population density from 2025 population estimates and Census ALAND values.

encoding.position: Census boundary rings projected with a spherical Albers equal-area transform and normalized into scene space
encoding.color: log10 of Vintage 2025 resident population per Census ALAND square kilometer
encoding.topology: each shapefile ring is rendered as one polygon-set region; interior holes are not preserved

dataset.provenance: The showcase loads a PDB coordinate file, normalizes atom positions into scene space, and renders atoms as sphere impostors with element-style colors and radii from the preparation bundle.

encoding.color: element-style atom colors from the preparation bundle
